articles.title: Toward Automated Detection of Documentation Inconsistencies in Electronic Health Records
articles.abstract: Objective: To characterize the kinds of internal documentation inconsistencies a general-domain large language model (LLM) can surface from real-world discharge summaries, and to identify recurring failure modes that limit reliability at scale. Materials and Methods: We applied a two-stage LLM pipeline---open-ended candidate identification (Gemini 2.5 Pro) followed by context-grounded verification (Gemini 2.5 Flash)---to 3,000 randomly sampled MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries. A subset of the pipeline output was then reviewed manually by clinical experts. Results: Our pipeline surfaced 3,460 candidate inconsistencies, affecting 69.7% of admissions. Representative examples spanned demographics, allergies, procedures, diagnoses, laboratory, medications, and care-planning domains, with direct implications for clinical reasoning or patient safety. Expert review also revealed recurring failure modes that arise when verification requires temporal reasoning, evolving-diagnosis context, or knowledge of outpatient-prescribing conventions the model does not natively possess. Discussion: Detection is highly context-dependent: many flagged pairs require anchoring each statement to its source section and clinical domain, then assessing whether the conflict reflects a true contradiction or missing context. We propose a graded ontology spanning strict contradiction and ambiguity, with a schema characterizing each flagged case by category, section, domain, and inconsistency axis. Conclusion: This formative study establishes a methodological foundation and conceptual framework to guide subsequent validated, large-scale EHR-inconsistency analysis.
articles.titleCn: 电子健康记录中文档不一致性的自动检测
articles.abstractCn: 目标：表征通用领域大型语言模型（LLM）从真实世界出院记录中可以发现的各种内部文档不一致性，并识别限制其大规模可靠性的重复性失效模式。材料与方法：我们应用了一个两阶段LLM流程——开放式候选识别（Gemini 2.5 Pro）随后进行基于上下文的验证（Gemini 2.5 Flash）——对3,000份随机抽样的MIMIC-IV-Note出院记录进行处理。然后，由临床专家手动审查流程输出的一部分。结果：我们的流程发现了3,460个候选不一致性，影响了69.7%的入院记录。代表性示例涵盖了人口统计、过敏、手术、诊断、实验室、药物和护理计划等多个领域，直接关系到临床推理或患者安全。专家审查还揭示了当验证需要时间推理、演变诊断上下文或模型本身不具备的门诊处方惯例知识时出现的重复性失效模式。讨论：检测高度依赖于上下文：许多标记的对需要将每条陈述与其来源部分和临床领域锚定，然后评估冲突是否反映真正的矛盾或缺失的上下文。我们提出了一种涵盖严格矛盾和模糊性的分级本体，并设计了一个模式来通过类别、部分、领域和矛盾轴对每个标记案例进行表征。结论：这项形成性研究建立了一种方法论基础和概念框架，以指导后续经过验证的大规模EHR不一致性分析。

articles.title: Two Views, One Voice: Evidence-Grounded Conversational Music Recommendation
articles.abstract: Traditional conversational recommenders entangle retrieval and response generation within a single text interface, so exact entity cues fade as the dialogue's intent evolves, which compromises explanation credibility. We address this within the ACM RecSys Challenge 2026, which mandates both top-20 ranking and evidence-grounded response generation. This paper presents the third-place solution by team "swyoo" for the Blind-B industry track. We decouple retrieval and response into separate pipelines connected strictly via ranked tracks and metadata. Retrieval combines a hybrid lexical-dense pool for exact matching with a task-adapted pool driven by fine-tuned Qwen 8B adapters. Candidates are calibrated via LightGBM, then routed to an evidence-grounded propose-assign-select (PAS) framework to structure responses. This system also ranked second on the explanation-quality leaderboard in the final blind evaluation. Our findings demonstrate that: (i) isolating retrieval and response preserves both catalog cues and fluid intent; (ii) structuring generation via explicit evidence assignment is key to this near-best-in-class explanation reliability.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. 4th-place solution (team swyoo) in the Blind-B industry track of the ACM RecSys Challenge 2026
articles.titleCn: 基于证据的对话式音乐推荐：两种视角，一种声音
articles.abstractCn: 传统对话式推荐器将检索和回复生成整合在单一文本界面中，导致随着对话意图的演变，精确实体线索逐渐模糊，从而损害了解释的可信度。我们在ACM RecSys Challenge 2026中解决这个问题，该挑战要求同时实现前20名排名和基于证据的回复生成。本文介绍了"swyoo"团队在盲-商业赛道上的第三名解决方案。我们将检索和回复生成解耦为独立的流程，通过排名轨迹和元数据严格连接。检索结合了混合词表-密集池进行精确匹配，以及由微调Qwen 8B适配器驱动的任务适配池。候选项通过LightGBM校准，然后路由到基于证据的提议-分配-选择（PAS）框架来构建回复。该系统在最终盲测中的解释质量排行榜上也位列第二。我们的研究结果表明：(i)分离检索和回复生成既保留了目录线索，又保持了流畅的意图；(ii)通过明确的证据分配来构建生成是获得近乎最佳解释可靠性的关键。

articles.title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
articles.abstract: A key question for AI safety is whether a language model expresses all of its reasoning in its output tokens. We demonstrate a concrete failure mode where frontier models exhibit invisible reasoning by leveraging semantically irrelevant filler tokens to improve performance on synthetic reasoning tasks. We evaluate 13 frontier language models across three tasks and find that many models benefit significantly from filler tokens, with accuracy improvements of up to 13 percentage points. The benefit depends on which tokens are used and differs across models. We further show that filler tokens enable Claude Opus 4.5 to satisfy a hidden modular arithmetic constraint without sacrificing accuracy on its primary task, demonstrating that invisible reasoning can serve objectives entirely invisible to CoT monitoring. Reinforcement learning gives Qwen3-235B strong preferences over filler token content, but neither RL nor supervised fine-tuning produces a filler token benefit that persists at test time. Our results indicate that frontier models already perform consequential computation with no interpretable trace in their output tokens.
articles.titleCn: 并非所有大语言模型的推理过程都在思维链中可见
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能安全的一个关键问题是语言模型是否将其所有推理都表达在其输出标记中。我们展示了一种具体的失效模式：前沿模型通过利用在语义上无关的填充标记来提高在合成推理任务上的性能，从而表现出不可见的推理。我们在三个任务上评估了13个前沿语言模型，发现许多模型从填充标记中显著受益，准确率提高了高达13个百分点。这种收益取决于所使用的标记，并且在不同模型之间存在差异。我们进一步表明，填充标记使Claude Opus 4.5能够满足一个隐藏的模运算约束，而不会牺牲其在主要任务上的准确率，这证明不可见推理可以服务于CoT监控完全无法察觉的目标。强化学习赋予Qwen3-235B对填充标记内容的强烈偏好，但强化学习或监督微调都没有产生在测试时仍然持续的填充标记收益。我们的结果表明，前沿模型已经在其输出标记中执行了重要的计算，但没有可解释的痕迹。

articles.title: Simple Language Normalization Wins: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification for the TidyVoice 2026 Challenge
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual mismatch remains a key source of overall degradation in modern speaker verification. The TidyVoice2026 Challenge targets this setting with text-independent verification, comprising 3,666 training and 808 development speakers in 40 languages and 2,200 evaluation speakers in 38 unseen languages, without language labels at test time. Starting from the official SimAM-ResNet34 baseline pretrained on VoxBlink2 and VoxCeleb2 and fine-tuned on TidyVoice, we revisit Nuisance Attribute Projection (NAP) as a simple language-normalization step in the embedding space. We estimate a compact language subspace from cross-language same-speaker differences and project embeddings onto its orthogonal complement before cosine scoring with Adaptive Symmetric score normalization. This reduces development EER from 2.97\% with cosine and 2.70\% with AS-Norm to 2.18\% and yields a Codabench evaluation score of 8.40, showing that simple back-end language normalization can rival more complex systems.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures (submitted to the TidyVoice challenge colocated with Interspeech2026)
articles.titleCn: 简单语言归一化获胜：TidyVoice 2026挑战的跨语言说话人验证
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言不匹配仍然是现代说话人验证中整体性能下降的关键原因。TidyVoice2026挑战赛针对这一场景，采用文本无关验证方式，包含40种语言的3,666名训练说话人和808名开发说话人，以及38种未见过语言的2,200名评估说话人，测试时无需语言标签。我们从在VoxBlink2和VoxCeleb2上预训练并在TidyVoice上微调的官方SimAM-ResNet34基线模型出发，重新审视干扰属性投影（NAP）作为嵌入空间中的简单语言归一化步骤。我们从跨语言同说话人差异中估计一个紧凑的语言子空间，并将嵌入投影到其正交补空间上，然后再使用自适应对称分数归一化进行余弦评分。这将开发集EER从使用余弦函数的2.97%和使用AS-Norm的2.70%降低到2.18%，并获得了Codabench评估分数8.40，表明简单的后端语言归一化可以媲美更复杂的系统。

articles.title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumptions a first-class artifact of LLM-based code generation. In addition to code, AssumptionMiner produces an explicit assumption layer, a structured representation of inferred constraints and design decisions that developers can inspect, confirm, or revise. An AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only the code affected by a revised assumption. We also introduce a benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions, including a human-verified subset for evaluating code localization. We evaluate assumption extraction, code localization, and assumption-guided regeneration. Across open-source LLMs, a confidence-weighted ensemble achieves an F1 score of 0.816 for assumption extraction, improving on the strongest offline baseline by 3.6x. On the human-verified localization benchmark, AST-guided localization identifies more precise code regions than keyword-based and whole-file baselines. During assumption revision, targeted regeneration modifies less code than non-targeted alternatives while exposing challenges in handling cascading edits. These results demonstrate that making assumptions explicit improves the transparency and controllability of LLM-based code generation.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21535058
articles.titleCn: 假设挖掘器：提取、追踪和修订大型语言模型代码生成中的隐含假设
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够根据自然语言提示生成代码，然而现实中的提示很少提供完整的规格说明。当提示未明确输入格式、错误处理或设计决策时，LLMs会通过隐含假设来填补这些空白，这些假设会塑造生成代码的行为和正确性。由于这些假设保持隐藏，生成的代码可能通过测试但违背了开发者的意图。我们提出了AssumptionMiner框架，将隐含假设作为基于LLM代码生成的一流产物。除了代码之外，AssumptionMiner还会生成一个显式的假设层，这是一个开发者可以检查、确认或修订的推断约束和设计决策的结构化表示。基于抽象语法树（AST）的依赖图能够针对性地仅重新生成受修订假设影响的代码。我们还引入了一个包含180个模糊编程任务和676个标注假设的基准，其中包括一个供评估代码定位的人工验证子集。我们评估了假设提取、代码定位和假设引导的再生。在开源LLMs中，置信度加权的集成模型在假设提取方面达到了0.816的F1分数，比最强的离线基线提高了3.6倍。在人工验证的定位基准上，基于AST的定位比基于关键词和整个文件基线识别出更精确的代码区域。在假设修订过程中，针对性再生修改的代码少于非针对性替代方案，同时暴露了处理级联编辑的挑战。这些结果表明，使假设显式化提高了基于LLM代码生成的透明度和可控性。

articles.title: CHiPS: Character Histograms and Positional Signals for Lightweight Authorship Attribution in Romanian Texts

authors.name: George C. Ţurcaş
authors.affiliation: binary indicator sequences over character positions

articles.abstract: We propose CHiPS, a lightweight character-level authorship attribution method for Romanian texts. All reported experiments are closed-set: the true author is one of the candidate authors in the training data. CHiPS studies two complementary fingerprints of writing style: CH-SVM, a character-histogram classifier based on one-character marginal distributions, and FFT12-LR, a positional-signal classifier that represents selected characters and punctuation classes as impulse trains (binary indicator sequences over character positions) and extracts Fourier/Welch spectral descriptors. We also report CHiPS-F, a leakage-safe decision-level fusion variant, and an optional top-5 listwise reranker trained only on out-of-fold predictions. The method requires no tokenization, syntactic analysis, pretrained language model, or transformer fine-tuning, and it avoids character $n$-gram features with $n \geq 2$ in the histogram component. On a locked grouped ROST split comprising 400 files from 392 source-text groups, written by 10 authors, with source-text-level evaluation and grouped five-fold model selection, CHiPS-F reaches 0.9310 accuracy and 0.9341 macro-F1. A matched but unrestricted character 2--5-gram TF--IDF SVM comparator reaches 1.0000 accuracy and macro-F1 on the same held-out groups, so the contribution is not a claim of best possible classification accuracy. Instead, the experiments ask how far restricted, transparent character evidence can go under strict leakage control. On ROSTories-cleaned, a secondary ROST-overlapping corpus comprising 1,248 files from 1,240 source-text groups, written by 19 authors, the same protocol gives 0.8919 accuracy and 0.8708 macro-F1 for CHiPS-R.
articles.titleCn: CHiPS：用于罗马尼亚文本轻量级作者归属的角色直方图和位置信号
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了CHiPS，一种用于罗马尼亚文本的轻量级字符级作者归属方法。所有报告的实验都是封闭集：真实作者是在训练数据中的候选作者之一。CHiPS研究了两种互补的写作风格指纹：CH-SVM，一种基于单字符边缘分布的字符直方图分类器；以及FFT12-LR，一种位置信号分类器，它将选定的字符和标点类表示为脉冲序列（字符位置上的二元指示序列），并提取傅里叶/韦尔奇频谱描述符。我们还报告了CHiPS-F，一种防止信息泄露的决策级融合变体，以及一个仅基于折叠外预测训练的可选前五列表级重新排序器。该方法无需分词、句法分析、预训练语言模型或Transformer微调，并在直方图组件中避免了字符n-gram特征（n≥2）。在一个包含来自392个源文本组的400个文件的锁定分组ROST拆分中，由10位作者撰写，采用源文本级评估和分组五折模型选择，CHiPS-F达到了0.9310的准确率和0.9341的宏观F1值。一个匹配但不受限制的字符2--5-gram TF-IDF SVM比较器在同一保留组上达到了1.0000的准确率和宏观F1值，因此贡献并非声称最佳可能的分类准确率。相反，实验探究在严格的信息泄露控制下，受限的透明字符证据可以达到多远。在ROSTories-cleaned，一个包含来自1240个源文本组的1248个文件的次级ROST重叠语料库中，由19位作者撰写，相同的协议为CHiPS-R提供了0.8919的准确率和0.8708的宏观F1值。

articles.title: PatiGonit22K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Solving Complex Bengali MWPs
articles.abstract: Mathematical Word Problems (MWPs) are an important benchmark for evaluating natural language understanding and quantitative reasoning. Despite recent progress in high resource languages, Bengali remains underexplored due to the limited availability of large scale annotated datasets. In this work, we introduce PatiGonit22K, an expanded Bengali MWP dataset containing 22,441 problems, developed by extending the original PatiGonit dataset with a substantially larger collection of complex mathematical problems. The dataset includes both simple and multi operation equations, providing a balanced benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning across different difficulty levels. Each problem is carefully translated, annotated, culturally adapted, and verified to ensure linguistic consistency and mathematical correctness. By increasing both the scale and complexity of Bengali MWPs, PatiGonit22K provides a more comprehensive resource for future research on mathematical reasoning and educational NLP applications in low resource languages.
articles.titleCn: PatiGonit22K：用于解决复杂孟加拉语多词短语问题的综合数据集
articles.abstractCn: 数学应用题（MWPs）是评估自然语言理解和定量推理能力的重要基准。尽管在高资源语言方面取得了近期进展，但由于大规模标注数据集的缺乏，孟加拉语仍然研究不足。在本工作中，我们介绍了PatiGonit22K，这是一个扩展的孟加拉语MWP数据集，包含22,441道题目，通过扩展原始PatiGonit数据集并加入大量复杂的数学问题而构建。该数据集包含简单和多操作方程，为不同难度级别的数学推理提供了均衡的基准。每个题目都经过仔细翻译、标注、文化适应和验证，以确保语言一致性和数学正确性。通过增加孟加拉语MWPs的规模和复杂性，PatiGonit22K为低资源语言的数学推理和教育NLP应用研究提供了更全面的资源。

articles.title: Language-Routed RAG and Direct Option Scoring for Multilingual Financial QA: DS@GT at FinMMEval
articles.abstract: We present DS@GT's submission to FinMMEval 2026 Task 1, a multilingual financial exam question answering benchmark spanning English, Spanish, Greek, Chinese, and Hindi. Financial certification exams such as the CFA, EFPA, and CPA demand structured domain reasoning that standard NLP benchmarks do not capture, and this challenge compounds across languages where retrieval and representation infrastructure is underdeveloped. We build a retrieval-augmented pipeline on LangGraph that detects query language and retrieves semantically relevant exemplars from a 30,209-entry multilingual knowledge base using BGE-M3 embeddings and FAISS indexing. The system then scores answers via Retrieval-Augmented Direct Scoring (RADS), reading next-token log-probabilities over candidate option letters rather than generating free-form output. For low-resource languages, we fuse per-language and cross-lingual retrieval indices using weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Model selection is language-routed: Qwen3-14B for Arabic, Chinese, and Hindi; Qwen2.5-14B for English; and Llama-3.1-8B for Greek, a routing derived from empirical ablations that reveal substantial language-asymmetric performance gaps. Notably, chain-of-thought prompting significantly degrades Greek accuracy (90.7% to 20.9%), and enabling Qwen3's default thinking mode collapses Arabic RADS performance to near-chance levels. Our results indicate that effective multilingual financial reasoning requires language-aware retrieval, model routing, and deliberate scoring strategy selection.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Working Notes. 15 pages, 3 figures
articles.titleCn: 多语言金融问答中的语言路由RAG和直接选项评分：FinMMEval上的DS@GT
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了DS@GT针对FinMMEval 2026任务1的提交方案，这是一个涵盖英语、西班牙语、希腊语、中文和印地语的多语言金融考试问题回答基准。金融认证考试如CFA、EFPA和CPA需要结构化的领域推理，而标准NLP基准无法捕捉这一点，并且这种挑战在检索和表示基础设施欠发达的语言中更为突出。我们在LangGraph上构建了一个检索增强型流水线，该流水线检测查询语言，并使用BGE-M3嵌入和FAISS索引从包含30,209条目的多语言知识库中检索语义相关的范例。系统随后通过检索增强直接评分（RADS）对答案进行评分，通过读取候选选项字母的下一个标记对数概率，而不是生成自由形式的输出。对于低资源语言，我们使用加权互惠排名融合（Reciprocal Rank Fusion）融合了每语言和跨语言的检索索引。模型选择基于语言路由：阿拉伯语、中文和印地语使用Qwen3-14B；英语使用Qwen2.5-14B；希腊语使用Llama-3.1-8B，这一路由源于经验消融实验，揭示了显著的跨语言性能差异。值得注意的是，思维链提示显著降低了希腊语的准确率（从90.7%降至20.9%），而启用Qwen3的默认思维模式使阿拉伯语的RADS性能降至接近随机水平。我们的结果表明，有效的多语言金融推理需要语言感知检索、模型路由和审慎的评分策略选择。

articles.title: Frustratingly Simple Black-Box Adaptation of Language Models via Logit Bias
articles.abstract: Many organizations aim to adapt language models for internal use, both to improve performance on domain-specific tasks and to address privacy concerns around sensitive data. However, such adaptation remains non-trivial: it often requires operationally challenging fine-tuning of open-source models or ad hoc prompt optimization. We study a minimal alternative based on a simple API-level control: allowing users to bias the model's logits with a user-defined vector. We develop a black-box method for learning a single context-independent logit-bias vector, added at every decoding step, without modifying model weights or requiring gradients. Starting from a KL-regularized reinforcement learning (RL) objective, we characterize when such a fixed logit-bias vector can approximate the optimal prefix-dependent correction and derive a closed-form inverse-propensity estimator from rollouts, rewards, and token probabilities. Empirically, this simple decoding-time intervention improves over base models on mathematical and reasoning benchmarks while using far fewer trainable parameters than conventional fine-tuning. Our results suggest that learned logit bias is a lightweight mechanism for adapting language models under minimal access requirements.

articles.titleCn: 令人沮丧的通过逻辑偏置进行语言模型的黑盒适配
articles.abstractCn: 许多组织旨在将语言模型用于内部应用，以提高特定领域任务的性能，并解决敏感数据相关的隐私问题。然而，这种适配仍然具有挑战性：它通常需要对开源模型进行操作上困难的微调，或进行临时的提示优化。我们研究了一种基于简单API级控制的极简替代方案：允许用户使用用户定义的向量来偏置模型的logits。我们开发了一种黑盒方法，用于学习一个上下文无关的logit偏置向量，该向量在每个解码步骤中添加，而无需修改模型权重或计算梯度。从KL正则化的强化学习（RL）目标出发，我们描述了这种固定logit偏置向量何时可以近似最优的前缀依赖性校正，并从滚动、奖励和token概率中推导出闭式逆倾向估计器。实证结果表明，这种简单的解码时干预在数学和推理基准测试中优于基础模型，同时使用的可训练参数远少于传统的微调。我们的结果表明，学习到的logit偏置是一种在最小访问要求下适配语言模型的轻量级机制。

articles.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
articles.abstract: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. Empirical evaluations on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Skill-SP, serving as a robust evolution engine, consistently pushes the performance ceiling of competent backbones while catalyzing striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play.
articles.titleCn: 技能自博弈：通过协同进化的技能推动大语言模型能力的边界
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型训练正从手动设计和标注转向交互驱动的自我进化。然而，现有的自我进化方法面临着任务多样性和验证可靠性之间的根本困境：受环境约束的方法能获得精确的反馈，但将学习局限于狭窄领域，而开放式自我生成虽然扩展了任务空间，却缺乏可靠的验证，导致误导性奖励污染训练循环。我们识别出智能体技能作为调和这一矛盾的有效途径：每个技能确保在特定场景下进行深入、可验证的执行，而跨技能的动态路由则保持开放式的任务多样性。基于这一见解，我们提出了技能自我博弈（Skill-SP），这是一个协同进化的框架，包含提议者、求解者和动态技能控制器。通过强化学习循环协调，这些组件在持续的自我博弈循环中协同进化：提议者根据动态采样的技能生成具有挑战性的任务；求解者探索候选解决方案以拓展其能力边界；技能控制器收集执行反馈以更新和扩展技能库。这种交互式协同进化有效地弥合了结构化验证和开放式探索之间的差距。在工具使用和推理基准上的实证评估表明，作为强大的进化引擎，Skill-SP始终推动有能力的骨干模型的性能上限，同时为最初不匹配的模型带来显著的转变。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play 获取。

articles.title: Opaque Epistemic Mediation: How LLM Deployment Configurations Shape the Validation of Pseudo-Science
articles.abstract: Commercial large language models are increasingly used as knowledge references, yet their stance on contested scientific claims is neither stable nor transparent. We tested how four major LLM families (Claude, Grok, GPT, Gemini) evaluate ethnonationalist pseudo-science derived from Frank Salter's biosocial framework across four temporal snapshots (October 2025-February 2026), via both API and web interfaces. Grok's Fast versions (which power the default user experience on X) consistently assigned credibility scores of 70-75, two to five times higher than all other models (which scored 15-40). This pattern was absent from control prompts testing basic evolutionary consensus and refuted Lamarckian claims, where all models performed comparably. Three additional findings emerged: (1) a silent patch reversed Grok's behaviour from chaotic to stably high validation overnight, without any public documentation; (2) the same Grok model identifier produced radically divergent outputs via API (75) and an unstable, near-zero collapse via web (mean 5.5) three months later; (3) refusal to rate the pseudo-scientific claim, the most defensible response observed, appeared in two model families through different interfaces (Claude Opus 4.1 categorically via web, GPT-5.1 Chat intermittently via API) and eroded in the successor version of each. These results indicate that the epistemic stance of a commercial LLM is not a stable property of the model but a contingent effect of deployment configuration: system prompts, safety layers, interface routing, and silent updates. This remains opaque to users and researchers alike. We argue this constitutes a matter of public concern requiring new forms of epistemic accountability.
articles.titleCn: 不透明认知中介：大型语言模型部署配置如何影响伪科学的验证
articles.abstractCn: 商业大型语言模型正日益被用作知识参考，但它们对有争议的科学主张的立场既不稳定也不透明。我们测试了四大主要LLM系列（Claude、Grok、GPT、Gemini）在四个时间快照（2025年10月至2026年2月）中，通过API和网页界面如何评估源自Frank Salter生物社会框架的民族国家主义伪科学。Grok的Fast版本（为X的默认用户体验提供支持）始终给予70-75的信誉评分，是其他所有模型（评分15-40）的两到五倍。这种模式在测试基本进化共识和反驳拉马克主义主张的控制提示中并未出现，所有模型在这些测试中表现相当。此外还发现了三点发现：（1）一个静默的补丁使Grok的行为从混乱变为稳定的高验证，且没有任何公开文档记录；（2）同一Grok模型标识符通过API（75）和三个月后通过网页（平均5.5）产生了截然不同的输出，后者表现不稳定且接近崩溃；（3）拒绝对伪科学主张进行评分，这是观察到的最合理的回应，出现在两个模型系列的不同界面中（Claude Opus 4.1通过网页明确拒绝，GPT-5.1 Chat通过API间歇性拒绝），并在每个系列的后续版本中逐渐削弱。这些结果表明，商业LLM的认知立场并非模型的稳定属性，而是部署配置的偶然效应：系统提示、安全层、界面路由和静默更新。这一点对用户和研究人员来说都仍然不透明。我们认为这构成了一项公共关切问题，需要新的认知问责形式。

articles.title: The Best Programming Language for Tokenmaxxing: An Investigation of Coding Agent Behavior Across Programming Languages
articles.abstract: Although coding agents are now very effective in a variety of programming languages, this paper first shows that the cost (in tokens) can very significantly by programming language. We evaluate five recent models on programming problems in Python, Java, Rust, and OCaml. We carefully control for problem difficulty, and show that there can be stark variation in token consumption that is consistent across models. To understand why, we analyze both the structure and content of agent trajectories. First, we re-execute every intermediate solution and abstract each trajectory as a sequence of test-outcome vectors, then label the work between successive solutions. This reveals agents repeatedly producing noncompiling solutions in unfamiliar languages and revising solutions that already pass. Second, we analyze trajectory text, finding that agents plan solutions in code comments, distrust the provided tests in favor of inputs they invent, and sidestep unfamiliar target languages by prototyping in Python. Our results show that by-language token efficiency is a metric that should be considered when benchmarking and developing multilingual agents, and, for the tokenmaxxer, a guide to the most expensive language to work in.
articles.titleCn: 最适合Tokenmaxxing的编程语言：跨编程语言的编码代理行为研究
articles.abstractCn: 尽管编码代理在各种编程语言中现已非常有效，本文首先表明，编程语言的成本（以token计）可能差异显著。我们在Python、Java、Rust和OCaml中的编程问题上评估了五种最新模型。我们仔细控制问题难度，并展示了不同模型间token消耗存在显著差异且具有一致性。为理解原因，我们分析了代理轨迹的结构和内容。首先，我们重新执行每个中间解决方案，并将每个轨迹抽象为一系列测试结果向量，然后标记连续解决方案之间的工作。这揭示代理在陌生语言中反复生成非编译解决方案，并修改已通过的解决方案。其次，我们分析了轨迹文本，发现代理在代码注释中规划解决方案，更信任自己编写的输入而非提供的测试，并通过用Python进行原型设计来规避不熟悉的编程语言。我们的结果表明，按语言计的token效率是评估和开发多语言代理时应考虑的指标，对于tokenmaxxer而言，它也是衡量最难工作的语言指南。

articles.title: grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
articles.abstract: Existing lexical distance, similarity, and evaluation metrics operate on Unicode code points, which can misrepresent errors in writing systems where a single grapheme is represented by multiple Unicode code points. We introduce grapheme-kit, an open-source Python library that extends these metrics to operate on grapheme clusters instead. The library also provides improved grapheme processing for Tamil and Sinhala, including accurate grapheme cluster identification and grapheme composition/decomposition utilities. Through an OCR case study, we demonstrate that grapheme-level metrics provide a more faithful evaluation of complex scripts.
articles.titleCn: grapheme-kit：多语言NLP中的字素级指标和文本处理
articles.abstractCn: 现有的词汇距离、相似度和评估度量基于Unicode码点进行计算，这可能导致在书写系统中，一个字符由多个Unicode码点表示时出现错误。我们引入了grapheme-kit，一个开源的Python库，该库将这些度量扩展到基于字符簇进行计算。该库还提供了对泰米尔语和僧伽罗语的改进字符处理，包括精确的字符簇识别和字符组合/分解工具。通过一个OCR案例研究，我们证明了字符级度量能更忠实地评估复杂脚本。

articles.title: A Factorial Study of Synthetic Data Generation for Low-Resource Machine Translation using Grammar Books
articles.abstract: Most endangered languages lack the parallel data required for machine translation, despite the existence of descriptive grammar books. We introduce a pipeline that uses large language models to extract grammatical rules, example sentences, and lexicons from grammar books and generate synthetic parallel corpora for fine-tuning-rather than feeding grammar content into prompts at inference time, as in prior work. Validated on three typologically diverse low-resource languages-Kalamang (Papuan), Tuatschin (Romance), and Mandan (Siouan)-we show that fine-tuning on synthetic data improves over seed-data baselines in 75% of configurations for Kalamang and 59% for Tuatschin, with best-case ChrF++ gains of +8.8, +5.3, and +3.3 respectively. Through a systematic factorial study across 96 configurations varying target part-of-speech, retrieval granularity, and sample volume, we identify which factor combinations drive gains and where they break down. Our results demonstrate that static linguistic documentation can be repurposed for machine translation fine-tuning, offering a practical path towards translation tools for severely under-resourced languages.
articles.titleCn: 针对低资源机器翻译的合成数据生成：基于语法书的因子实验研究
articles.abstractCn: 尽管存在描述性语法书籍，大多数濒危语言缺乏机器翻译所需的平行数据。我们介绍一个使用大型语言模型从语法书中提取语法规则、例句和词汇，并生成合成平行语料库以进行微调的流程——这与先前工作中将语法内容输入推理时的提示不同。我们在三种类型学差异显著的低资源语言——卡拉曼格语（巴布亚语系）、图阿茨钦语（罗曼语族）和曼丹语（苏语族）——上进行了验证，表明在合成数据上进行微调在75%的配置中优于卡拉曼格语的种子数据基线，在59%的配置中优于图阿茨钦语，最佳情况下的ChrF++增益分别为+8.8、+5.3和+3.3。通过在96种配置中进行系统的因子研究，这些配置在目标词性、检索粒度和样本量上有所变化，我们确定了哪些因素组合能带来增益，以及它们在何处失效。我们的结果表明，静态语言文献可以被改用于机器翻译微调，为严重资源匮乏语言提供了一条实用的翻译工具开发路径。

articles.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization

authors.name: Kun Yuan
authors.affiliation: a condition satisfied at more than 99% of training positions

articles.abstract: Open-weight language models from different families exhibit complementary capabilities, motivating their consolidation into a compact student through on-policy distillation (OPD). However, full-vocabulary OPD typically assumes a shared tokenizer, while existing cross-tokenizer methods may discard teacher probability mass or assign it to student tokens with unrelated content. We introduce Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM), which re-expresses the teacher's next-token distribution over the student vocabulary in a shared byte space. Specifically, BPM assigns each teacher token's probability to the longest student token whose byte representation is a prefix of the teacher token's bytes, aggregates mass mapped to the same student token, and places otherwise unmatched mass in an explicit residual category. This produces a vocabulary-complete, byte-aligned, and mass-preserving target for dense OPD. The target exactly recovers the teacher-induced byte-prefix marginal when the relevant prefix does not span multiple teacher tokens (a condition satisfied at more than 99% of training positions) and uses a mass-preserving, chain-factorized lower bound otherwise. Across Qwen3-32B, GLM-Z1-9B-0414, and MiniMax-M2.7 as teachers, BPM consistently outperforms current cross-tokenizer methods on six mathematics and programming benchmarks, improving six-benchmark avg@8 by 3.7-6.6 points over the strongest baselines.
articles.titleCn: 基于字节前缀边缘化的跨分词器在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 不同系列的开放权重语言模型展现出互补能力，这促使人们通过策略蒸馏（OPD）将它们整合到一个紧凑的学生模型中。然而，全词汇OPD通常假设共享分词器，而现有的跨分词器方法可能会丢弃教师概率质量或将其分配给与学生内容无关的学生标记。我们引入了字节前缀边缘化（BPM），它将教师下一个标记分布重新表述为在共享字节空间中针对学生词汇的分布。具体来说，BPM将每个教师标记的概率分配给字节表示是教师标记字节前缀的最长学生标记，将映射到相同学生标记的质量进行聚合，并将未匹配的质量放置在一个显式的残差类别中。这产生了一个词汇完整、字节对齐且质量保留的目标，用于密集OPD。当相关前缀不跨越多个教师标记时（这一条件在超过99%的训练位置得到满足），该目标精确地恢复了教师诱导的字节前缀边缘化；否则，它使用一个质量保留、链分解的下界。在Qwen3-32B、GLM-Z1-9B-0414和MiniMax-M2.7作为教师的情况下，BPM在六个数学和编程基准测试中始终优于当前的跨分词器方法，相较于最强基线，六基准平均@8指标提升了3.7-6.6个百分点。

articles.title: Multimodal Domain Generalization for Depression Detection: An Attention-Based BiLSTM Network with Domain-Adversarial Training
articles.abstract: Automatic depression detection with deep learning has shown promise but often suffers from limited generalization due to domain shift arising from inter-speaker variability. To address this critical issue, we present the first patient-independent multimodal depression detection framework that incorporates domain generalization (DG), jointly leveraging both acoustic and textual modalities. The proposed model integrates bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) with intra- and cross-modal attention mechanisms, accompanied by segment-level fusion for decision-making. Generalization is further enhanced by applying a gradient reversal layer inspired by Domain-Adversarial Training of Neural Networks (DANN), which promotes domain-invariant representations by adversarially limiting the model's ability to identify individual speakers, effectively reducing patient-specific bias. Conducting experiments on the Androids-Corpus dataset with a 5-fold cross-validation (CV) protocol, various pairings of audio and text feature extractors were evaluated over different segment durations, determining MelSpec and ItalianBERT as the optimal baseline at a 30-second segment duration. The addition of DG to this baseline yields a 2.5% increase in accuracy and 3.3% in F1-score, achieving 93.2% accuracy, 93.2% precision, 96.2% recall, and 94.2% F1-score, surpassing all existing benchmarks. Extensive ablation studies assess the impact of multimodal fusion, deep architectural choices, and DG, highlighting their combined contribution to robust and generalizable depression detection.

articles.titleCn: 用于抑郁症检测的多模态领域泛化：基于注意力的BiLSTM网络与领域对抗训练
articles.abstractCn: 基于深度学习的自动抑郁检测已展现出良好前景，但由于说话人差异导致的领域偏移问题，其泛化能力往往受限。为解决这一关键问题，我们提出了首个患者无关的多模态抑郁检测框架，该框架融合了领域泛化（DG），同时利用了声学和文本模态。所提出的模型集成了双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）与模态内及跨模态注意力机制，并辅以片段级融合进行决策。通过应用受神经网络的领域对抗训练（DANN）启发的梯度反转层，进一步增强泛化能力，该层通过对抗性地限制模型识别个体说话人的能力，促进领域不变表示，有效减少患者特定偏差。在Androids-Corpus数据集上采用5折交叉验证（CV）协议进行实验，评估了不同片段时长下音频和文本特征提取器的各种组合，确定MelSpec和ItalianBERT在30秒片段时长下为最佳基线。在该基线中添加DG后，准确率提升了2.5%，F1分数提升了3.3%，达到93.2%的准确率、93.2%的精确率、96.2%的召回率和94.2%的F1分数，超越了所有现有基准。广泛的消融研究评估了多模态融合、深度架构选择和DG的影响，突出了它们共同对鲁棒和泛化抑郁检测的贡献。

articles.title: Biomedical Machine Translation for Low-Resource Arabic-Script Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and LoRA Adapter Merging

authors.name: Arash Eslamighayour
authors.affiliation: Afghan Persian, a standardised variety of Persian

authors.name: Sarp Harbalioglu
authors.affiliation: Central Kurdish, a major standardized variety of Kurdish

articles.abstract: We present a systematic study of healthcare-domain cross-lingual transfer to address the scarcity of biomedical NMT resources for Arabic-script languages. We use Arabic and Persian as higher-resource pivots to improve translation for \textbf{four severely low-resource} targets: Dari (Afghan Persian, a standardised variety of Persian), Pashto, Sorani Kurdish (Central Kurdish, a major standardized variety of Kurdish), and Urdu (closely related to Hindi). Using LoRA fine-tuning on small decoder-only LLMs, we train \textit{domain-specific pivot adapters} and evaluate \textbf{three transfer strategies}: few-shot in-context learning, minimal supervised adaptation, and, to the best of our knowledge, for the first time in this setting, zero-data LoRA adapter merging. Supervised adaptation with just 500 sentences achieves near pivot-language quality for Dari (CHrF++ 41.01) and meaningful gains for Urdu (28.88), while adapter merging reaches within 3.5 CHrF++ of supervised adaptation for Dari at zero additional cost. Pashto and Sorani Kurdish remain insufficient for high-stakes clinical deployment exposing the limits of cross-lingual transfer when structural distance from the pivots is too great. LoRA adapter merging works surprisingly well for closely related languages, even without target-language biomedical data.
articles.titleCn: 基于跨语言迁移和LoRA适配器融合的低资源阿拉伯文字语言生物医学机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 我们针对阿拉伯语系语言在生物医学领域自然语言翻译资源稀缺的问题，开展了一项系统性的跨语言迁移学习研究。我们采用阿拉伯语和波斯语作为高资源枢纽语言，以提高对四个严重低资源目标的翻译质量：达里语（阿富汗波斯语，波斯语的一种标准化变体）、普什图语、索拉尼库尔德语（中部库尔德语，库尔德语的主要标准化变体）和乌尔都语（与印地语密切相关）。我们使用LoRA微调小型仅解码器的大型语言模型，训练了特定领域的枢纽适配器，并评估了三种迁移策略：少样本情境学习、最小化监督适应，以及据我们所知，首次在此场景中实现的零数据LoRA适配器合并。仅使用500个句子进行监督适应即可使达里语（CHrF++ 41.01）接近枢纽语言质量，并对乌尔都语（28.88）取得显著提升，而适配器合并在零额外成本下使达里语的CHrF++值达到监督适应的3.5以内。普什图语和索拉尼库尔德语仍不足以支持高风险的临床应用，这揭示了当与枢纽语言的结构距离过大时，跨语言迁移学习的局限性。令人惊讶的是，LoRA适配器合并对关系密切的语言效果出奇地好，即使没有目标语言的生物医学数据也能取得良好效果。

articles.title: Why Large Language Models and Humans Converge and Diverge in Evaluating Creativity
articles.abstract: Despite the growing use of large language models (LLMs) as creativity evaluators, evidence of their alignment with human evaluations remains mixed, raising the question of when and why their judgments converge with or diverge from human judgments. Across three studies and six widely used LLMs, we addressed this gap by identifying the standards underlying LLM creativity evaluation and examining their downstream implications. Study 1 showed that LLMs generally relied on a narrower subset of human creativity evaluation standards. Convergence with human standards was strongest in the novelty dimension, whereas divergence was clearest in the contextual dimension, which captures social, market, and reputational information. Moreover, each LLM exhibited distinct, model-specific standards that varied substantially in breadth. These differences in evaluation standards were reflected in actual creativity judgments. Study 2 (N = 1,103 ideas) showed that LLM evaluations were moderately correlated with human evaluations, and individual LLMs with broader standards better distinguished ideas humans judged as more versus less creative. Study 3 (N = 1,195) showed that LLMs were less sensitive to contextual information: such information significantly altered human creativity ratings but left LLM ratings largely unchanged. Together, our findings help explain the mixed evidence on LLM-human alignment, showing that alignment depends on the evidence a judgment demands and the standards each model applies. LLMs may resemble humans when evaluations emphasize intrinsic qualities such as novelty, yet diverge when judgments require contextual information. Selecting an LLM evaluator is therefore a consequential decision: different models, applying different standards, recognize different ideas as creative.
articles.titleCn: 为什么大型语言模型和人类在评估创造力上会趋同和分化
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）作为创意评估工具的使用日益广泛，但它们与人类评估的一致性证据仍然参差不齐，引发了关于何时以及为何它们的判断会与人类判断趋同或背离的问题。通过对三项研究和六种广泛使用的LLMs进行分析，我们通过识别LLMs创意评估背后的标准并考察其下游影响来填补这一空白。研究1表明，LLMs通常依赖于人类创意评估标准的一个较窄子集。在新颖性维度上，它们与人类标准的一致性最强，而在捕捉社会、市场和声誉信息的背景维度上，背离最为明显。此外，每种LLMs都表现出独特的、模型特定的标准，这些标准在广度上差异很大。这些评估标准的差异体现在实际的创意判断中。研究2（N = 1,103个创意）表明，LLMs的评估与人类评估中度相关，标准更广泛的LLMs能更好地区分人类判断为更具创意和较具创意的创意。研究3（N = 1,195）表明，LLMs对背景信息不太敏感：这类信息显著改变了人类的创意评分，但对LLMs的评分影响不大。综合来看，我们的研究结果有助于解释LLMs-人类一致性证据的复杂性，表明一致性取决于判断所要求的证据以及每个模型应用的标准。当评估强调新颖性等内在品质时，LLMs可能更接近人类，但在需要背景信息的判断中则会背离。因此，选择LLMs评估器是一个重要的决策：不同的模型应用不同的标准，会识别出不同的创意。

articles.title: Neuromorphic Diffusion Language Models: Addressing Compute and Memory Bottlenecks via Sparsity and Block Denoising
articles.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs) are inherently inefficient at inference time because each generated token requires accessing the full set of model parameters, leading to low operational intensity and high energy consumption. Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) partially address this limitation for memory-bound settings by allowing multiple tokens to be generated per parameter access. In order to further enhance inference efficiency on modern platforms with extensive in-chip memory, this work proposes neuromorphic MDLMs (N-MDLMs), which integrate block diffusion with spike-based neuromorphic computation to jointly improve throughput and energy efficiency. While block diffusion increases token throughput by producing multiple tokens per parameter access, spike-induced sparsity reduces effective parameter traffic and computations by skipping inactive channels. To analyze the synergistic effect of sparsity and diffusion, we develop a token-level roofline-inspired model that captures the combined impact of block-parallel generation and spike sparsity on decoding efficiency. Experimental results on translation tasks show that, thanks to spike-induced sparsity, N-MDLMs achieve substantial improvements in energy efficiency and throughput even in compute-bound platforms for which MDLMs would fail to improve over AR-LLMs.

articles.titleCn: 神经形态扩散语言模型：通过稀疏性和块去噪解决计算和内存瓶颈
articles.abstractCn: 自回归（AR）大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时本质上效率低下，因为每个生成的标记都需要访问完整的模型参数集，导致运算强度低且能耗高。掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）通过允许每次参数访问生成多个标记，在内存受限的设置中部分解决了这一限制。为了在现代具有大量片上内存的平台上进一步提升推理效率，本研究提出了神经形态MDLMs（N-MDLMs），该模型将块扩散与基于脉冲的神经形态计算相结合，以协同提升吞吐量和能效。块扩散通过每次参数访问生成多个标记来提高标记吞吐量，而脉冲诱导的稀疏性则通过跳过非激活通道来减少有效参数流量和计算量。为了分析稀疏性和扩散的协同效应，我们开发了一个基于标记级的屋顶线模型的框架，该框架捕捉了块并行生成和脉冲稀疏性对解码效率的综合影响。在翻译任务上的实验结果表明，得益于脉冲诱导的稀疏性，N-MDLMs即使在计算受限的平台上也能实现能效和吞吐量的显著提升，而MDLMs则无法在AR-LLMs上实现改进。

articles.title: From Isolated Tasks to Structured Capabilities: A Multilayer Taxonomy for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluation spans diverse tasks and benchmarks, yet evidence remains organized around tasks rather than the capabilities they probe. This fragmentation limits cross-study comparison, obscures capabilities tasks recruit, and makes coverage gaps difficult to identify. We introduce a multi-layer taxonomy of 14 capability domains and 91 subskills across Primitive, Constructed, and Integrative layers. Human cognitive science guides capability definition and organization, not LLM architecture. Layer assignments draw on developmental precedence and hypothesized functional support, while human-origin constructs are adapted to observable model behavior. To demonstrate operational utility, we screened 31,505 papers from ACL, AAAI, ICML, and NeurIPS between 2023 and 2025 and mapped 15,934 LLM-focused papers through multi-model annotation, consensus, and arbitration. Direct research attention concentrated on Language-Semantic Competence (3,551; 22.3%), Reasoning (3,388; 21.3%), Planning and Decision-Making (2,149; 13.5%), and Perception (1,954; 12.3%), whereas six domains appeared in fewer than 2% of papers. Within domains, the most frequent subskill had a median prevalence of 97.9% and appeared in at least 90% of papers in 10 of 14 domains. Language-Semantic Competence and Reasoning formed the highest-volume pair (n = 1,864; 11.7%; lift = 2.47), whereas Theory of Mind and Social Reasoning and Interaction showed the highest lift among pairs with at least 20 co-occurrences (n = 62; lift = 30.84). By shifting the unit of analysis from isolated tasks to structured capabilities, the taxonomy supports research organization, coverage audits, evaluation interpretation, and testable hypotheses for diagnosis, training, and transfer.
articles.titleCn: 从孤立任务到结构化能力：大型语言模型的多层分类法
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）评估涵盖了多样化的任务和基准，但现有证据仍围绕任务而非它们所探测的能力进行组织。这种碎片化限制了跨研究比较，模糊了任务所招募的能力，并使覆盖差距难以识别。我们引入了一个包含14个能力领域和91个子技能的多层分类体系，涵盖原始层、构建层和整合层。人类认知科学指导着能力的定义和组织，而非LLM架构。层级的分配基于发展先例和假设的功能支持，而人类起源的构建则适应于可观察的模型行为。为展示其实际效用，我们筛选了2023年至2025年间ACL、AAAI、ICML和NeurIPS发表的31,505篇论文，并通过多模型标注、共识和仲裁映射了15,934篇聚焦于LLM的论文。直接研究注意力集中于语言-语义能力（3,551篇；22.3%）、推理（3,388篇；21.3%）、规划和决策（2,149篇；13.5%）以及感知（1,954篇；12.3%），而六个领域的出现率低于论文总数的2%。在各个领域中，最常见的子技能中位出现率为97.9%，并在14个领域的10个中至少出现在90%的论文中。语言-语义能力和推理构成了最高量的组合（n=1,864；11.7%；提升因子=2.47），而心智理论和社会推理与交互在出现至少20次共现的组合中显示出最高的提升因子（n=62；提升因子=30.84）。通过将分析单元从孤立任务转向结构化能力，该分类体系支持研究组织、覆盖审计、评估解释，并为诊断、训练和迁移提供可检验的假设。

articles.title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents

authors.name: Junyang Jiang
authors.affiliation: multi-turn read-write interaction with a running database

authors.name: Xu Chen
authors.affiliation: causal diagnosis across thousands of time series, business logs, and concurrent activity

authors.name: Zibo Liang
authors.affiliation: multiple remediations with different operational trade-offs

authors.name: Kai Zheng
authors.affiliation: faults cascading across internal mechanisms and operational domains

articles.abstract: LLM-based database agents show promise, but differing task scopes, testbeds, and metrics hinder comparison. We identify four gaps between evaluation and production operations: live-environment fidelity (multi-turn read-write interaction with a running database); observation-space scale and complexity (causal diagnosis across thousands of time series, business logs, and concurrent activity); solution-space openness (multiple remediations with different operational trade-offs); and scenario complexity and coverage (faults cascading across internal mechanisms and operational domains). We present DBA-Bench, a benchmark addressing these gaps through production fidelity, outcome-first evaluation, and controlled scenario reproducibility. It uses instrumented PostgreSQL environments with active workloads, persistent state, and multi-source observations; defines success by measurable recovery or fault elimination under safety constraints; and restores snapshots with scenario-specific checks before each run. The benchmark contains 106 scenarios across seven task domains, with two public difficulty labels based on reference-path diagnostic depth and environmental complexity. We evaluate nine baseline groups, including six foundation-model systems, two GPT-5.5-backed database agents, and a Human DBA reference. Across 848 automated runs, Diagnosis, Outcome, and Safe Pass rates are 32.7%, 19.6%, and 12.4%; the best automated baseline reaches 17.9% Safe Pass versus 93.4% for the Human DBA reference. Automated Safe Pass falls from 19.6% on Easy scenarios to 7.6% on Hard scenarios, underscoring the difficulty of safe end-to-end remediation.
articles.titleCn: DBA-Bench：一个用于基于LLM的数据库操作代理的生产保真度基准
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的数据库代理展现出潜力，但不同的任务范围、测试平台和指标阻碍了比较。我们识别出评估与生产操作之间的四个差距：实时环境保真度（与运行数据库的多轮读写交互）、观测空间规模和复杂性（跨数千个时间序列、业务日志和并发活动的因果诊断）、解决方案空间开放性（具有不同运营权衡的多种修复方案）以及场景复杂度和覆盖范围（内部机制和运营域的故障级联）。我们提出了DBA-Bench，一个通过生产保真度、结果优先评估和受控场景可重复性解决这些差距的基准。它使用带主动工作负载、持久状态和多源观测的PostgreSQL环境；通过在安全约束下可衡量的恢复或故障消除来定义成功；并在每次运行前使用场景特定检查恢复快照。该基准包含涵盖七个任务域的106个场景，并基于参考路径诊断深度和环境复杂性设定两个公共难度标签。我们评估了九个基线组，包括六个基础模型系统、两个由GPT-5.5支持的数据库代理以及人类DBA参考。在848次自动运行中，诊断率、结果率和安全通过率为32.7%、19.6%和12.4%；最佳自动基线达到17.9%的安全通过率，而人类DBA参考为93.4%。自动安全通过率从Easy场景的19.6%降至Hard场景的7.6%，凸显了安全端到端修复的难度。

articles.title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
articles.abstract: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30, confirming the standalone predictive value of founder narratives. Feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers, including adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords, are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications, demonstrating that startup framing provides measurable signals for predicting Exit under conditions of high information asymmetry.
articles.titleCn: 从文本描述中预测创业公司退出——计算语言学框架
articles.abstractCn: 这项研究表明，仅凭文本描述就能预测创业公司早期成功（定义为退出），且无需依赖背景、财务或人力资本变量。研究利用涵盖20年间的7,419家创业公司的风险投资筛选数据集，通过创业叙事映射隔离文本框架变量，并构建了850个特征。研究评估了数据子集和向量嵌入的统计显著性，随后进行了六种模型的监督机器学习实验。LightGBM模型取得了最高的预测性能（F1=0.48），而仅凭文本描述的F1值为0.30，证实了创始人叙事的独立预测价值。特征分析显示，优化后的宣传标记密度（包括形容词、术语和流行语）与更高的退出概率相关，而过度陈述或名称长度过长则会降低该概率。研究还引入了可量化的宣传评分，用于风险投资申请，证明创业框架在信息不对称程度高的条件下提供了可测量的退出预测信号。

articles.title: Dynamic Commonsense Coordination for Empathetic Response Generation
articles.abstract: Empathetic Response Generation (ERG) requires models to recognize users' emotions and generate empathetic responses. Commonsense knowledge has been shown to support such reasoning, yet existing approaches typically reuse fixed commonsense representations across understanding and generation, limiting their ability to coordinate such knowledge across different stages. We propose DCC, a Dynamic Commonsense Coordination Framework with three complementary modules: residual-based commonsense interaction (SCE-AttnRes) to integrate contextual and situational commonsense representations, Association-Guided Commonsense Filtering (AGCF) to down-weight low-relevance commonsense relations, and Iterative Commonsense-Aware Decoding (ICAD) to dynamically retrieve commonsense memories during generation. Experiments on the Empathetic-Dialogues benchmark show that DCC improves emotion classification accuracy and response diversity over the CEM baseline while maintaining comparable perplexity. An LLM-based blind evaluation further demonstrates that DCC generates responses with better relevance, coherence, and informativeness. The code and implementation details will be publicly available at https://github.com/Hanabi-Q/DCC-ERG.
articles.titleCn: 动态常识协调生成共情回复
articles.abstractCn: 共情响应生成（ERG）要求模型识别用户的情绪并生成共情响应。常识知识已被证明支持此类推理，但现有方法通常在理解和生成过程中重复使用固定的常识表示，限制了它们在不同阶段协调此类知识的能力。我们提出了DCC，一个包含三个互补模块的动态常识协调框架：基于残差的常识交互（SCE-AttnRes）用于整合上下文和情境的常识表示，关联引导的常识过滤（AGCF）用于降低低相关性的常识关系权重，以及迭代常识感知解码（ICAD）用于在生成过程中动态检索常识记忆。在共情对话基准数据集上的实验表明，与CEM基线相比，DCC提高了情绪分类准确性和响应多样性，同时保持了相当的困惑度。基于LLM的盲评价进一步证明，DCC生成的响应具有更好的相关性、连贯性和信息量。代码和实现细节将在https://github.com/Hanabi-Q/DCC-ERG上公开发布。

articles.title: MEUSLI: a Multilingual Projector for LLM-based ASR and Beyond
articles.abstract: Lightweight projectors are an established way to connect pre-trained speech encoders with large language models (LLMs), mapping acoustic features into token-level embeddings for tasks like ASR and spoken question answering. Existing systems, however, typically only support a few languages and are often limited to English. We introduce MEUSLI, the first open-science multilingual projector family that links a Whisper encoder with open-source multilingual LLMs, enabling fully open-source end-to-end ASR in 28 European languages. MEUSLI extends prior monolingual pipelines, delivering strong results across high- and low-resource languages. Using proper continual leaning techniques, MEUSLI can be easily extended to other languages not seen in training. We further demonstrate that the MEUSLI projector can be leveraged beyond ASR, enabling multilingual speech translation and topic identification with only a few hours of task specific supervision per language. Overall, MEUSLI provides a solid foundation for multilingual speech understanding tasks, supporting scalable and inclu- sive open-source SpeechLLM
articles.titleCn: MEUSLI：一个基于LLM的语音识别和多语言投影仪项目
articles.abstractCn: 轻量级投影仪是连接预训练语音编码器与大型语言模型（LLM）的一种成熟方法，将声学特征映射到用于语音识别（ASR）和语音问答等任务的词级嵌入。然而，现有系统通常仅支持少数几种语言，并且往往局限于英语。我们介绍了MEUSLI，这是首个开源多语言投影仪系列，它将Whisper编码器与开源多语言LLM连接起来，实现了28种欧洲语言的完全开源端到端语音识别。MEUSLI扩展了先前的单语言流程，在高资源语言和低资源语言上均取得了优异成果。通过采用适当的持续学习技术，MEUSLI可以轻松扩展到训练中未出现过的其他语言。我们进一步证明，MEUSLI投影仪可以超越语音识别，仅需每种语言几小时的任务特定监督，即可实现多语言语音翻译和主题识别。总体而言，MEUSLI为多语言语音理解任务提供了坚实的基础，支持可扩展和包容性的开源SpeechLLM。

articles.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model
articles.abstract: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a Looped Transformer that reuses the layer stack to increase capacity without adding parameters. For SFT data and trajectory construction, we expand the diversity of executable environments, task assets, and agentic scaffolds through real-world deployment and large-scale synthesis. Our RL pipeline applies mixed-mode RLHF over Think and Non-Think responses to improve overall model quality and reduce failure cases, length-controlled reasoning RL to balance accuracy and reasoning efficiency, and agentic RL with outcome and process rewards to stabilize long-horizon training. Extensive evaluations show that Nanbeige4.2-3B outperforms larger models, including Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B, across diverse agentic benchmarks while remaining competitive on reasoning and alignment tasks. Performance with OpenClaw further supports its use as a compact local personal assistant.
articles.titleCn: Nanbeige4.2-3B：在紧凑模型中解锁自主能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Nanbeige4.2-3B，这是一个参数量仅为3B的非嵌入式紧凑型通用智能体模型。它在代码智能体、办公智能体和复杂工具使用任务中表现出色，同时在数学、编程和科学推理方面保持了极具竞争力的能力。Nanbeige4.2-3B从零开始在28T tokens上预训练，采用循环Transformer结构，通过复用层堆叠来增加容量而不增加参数。在SFT数据和轨迹构建方面，我们通过实际部署和大规模合成扩展了可执行环境的多样性、任务资产和智能体脚手架。我们的强化学习流程在思考和未思考响应上应用混合模式RLHF，以提升整体模型质量并减少失败案例；采用长度控制的推理RL来平衡准确性和推理效率；以及使用带有结果和过程奖励的智能体RL来稳定长时程训练。广泛的评估表明，Nanbeige4.2-3B在多种智能体基准测试中优于Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma4-12B等更大模型，同时在推理和一致性任务上保持竞争力。与OpenClaw结合使用进一步证明了其作为紧凑型本地个人助理的适用性。

articles.title: FSE: Continual Learning for Named Entity Recognition by Fast-Slow Experts
articles.abstract: Continual Learning for Named Entity Recognition (CLNER) enable models to incrementally learn new entity types without forgetting previously acquired ones. However, existing methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and insufficient exploitation of shared information across tasks. This paper proposes FSE, a Fast-Slow Experts enhanced span-based NER model for CLNER. The shared fast expert learns token-level links to efficiently filter out unlikely spans, while the task-specific slow expert performs span classification only on the remaining candidates. It stabilizes learning by promoting knowledge sharing across tasks and maintains plasticity by reducing learning burden at each task. A length-decay negative sampling strategy to mitigate span imbalance is also introduced. Extensive experiments on OntoNotes and FewNERD synthestic datasets demonstrate that FSE achieves state-of-the-art performance in CLNER scenarios, with effectiveness of each component, empirical evidence of faster convergence and expected functionality of both experts.
